title: Trump Posts Not-So-Subtle Boast About ‘Super Intelligence’ Victory Over Elon Musk
key_facts: Gizmodo says Elon Musk posted on X on Sunday 4 Oct that 'Super Intelligence' is a 'better' term than AI and that he intends to rename SpaceXAI 'SpaceXSI'.
Trump screenshotted the first post and shared it on Truth Social without comment.
Trump also announced a Super Intelligence Force task force led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton.
Its charter reportedly covers plans for 'SI-enabled threats' while avoiding overregulation.
Trump announced on 19 Sep that he planned to rebrand AI; Zuckerberg and Huang have used 'superintelligence' in posts.
Sam Altman has kept using 'AI' and said he is uncomfortable with people ascribing religious force to AI models.
quote_evidence: Musk declaring that Super Intelligence is a "better" term, and that he intends to rename SpaceXAI "SpaceXSI."
Trump clearly doesn't want the world to miss Musk's surrender
why_it_matters_hint: A naming fight over 'AI' versus 'Super Intelligence' tied to a new White House task force.
notes: Gizmodo's tone is commentary ('surrender', 'victory'); the framing is the outlet's interpretation. Facts about Musk's posts rely on Gizmodo's description, not read directly.
